comment: Enable (disable) use of compass if this status bit is 0 (1);

name: HYDROPHONE_DISABLE
comment: Enable (disable) use of hydrophone if this status bit is 0 (1);

comment: Enable (disable) use of piezo if this status bit is 0 (1);

name: TRANSMITTER_DISABLE
